causal_summary.extraction_method: copy causal depth, acyclicity, cycle, order-compatibility, and mismatch summaries.
causal_summary.normalization: front-depth fixed scale plus bounded relative causal-field distances
causal_summary.semantic_justification: Closure stability should preserve influence ordering, causal depth, and mismatch structure.

invariant_summary.extraction_method: copy normalized Phase 15 transport descriptors and Phase 18 shell-order score.
invariant_summary.normalization: bounded relative component distances at comparison time
invariant_summary.semantic_justification: Closure recovery should preserve coarse invariant descriptors under matched perturbation.

provenance_metadata.semantic_justification: Provenance must remain inspectable but cannot define closure identity.
provenance_metadata.source_artifact: CST observation metadata and source artifact hashes

shell_distance_surrogate_summary.extraction_method: copy shell-ordering metrics and per-shell distance-surrogate rows.
shell_distance_surrogate_summary.normalization: reported raw; selected fields contribute through component distances
shell_distance_surrogate_summary.semantic_justification: Shell-order and distance-surrogate fields are the repository-native closure-distance observables.

spectral_summary.extraction_method: copy low-mode fraction, low-mode power, and terminal fluctuation slope.
spectral_summary.normalization: bounded relative component distances at comparison time
spectral_summary.semantic_justification: Low-mode descriptors are part of the current closure observable surface.

stable_address_summary.extraction_method: copy dominant prefix, front depth profile, shell monotonicity, and compatibility band.
stable_address_summary.normalization: address prefix/depth distance with explicit floor audit
stable_address_summary.semantic_justification: Address fields provide a compact recovery address but do not alone define identity.

structural_graph_summary.extraction_method: derive transition edges from chain_signature and copy frozen edge-count summaries.
structural_graph_summary.normalization: edge-set Jaccard plus bounded count drift
structural_graph_summary.semantic_justification: Closure domains are represented by recovered event-transition and influence-edge organization.

temporal_sequence_summary.extraction_method: record chain_signature, transitions, available event times, and timing-source quality.
temporal_sequence_summary.normalization: rank distance plus tau-grid event-time distance; directly observed timing mode is separately auditable
temporal_sequence_summary.semantic_justification: Closure recoverability includes event ordering and recovered timing relations.
